baseline_result_note: This runbook records frozen baseline roles and evaluates the preregistered primary design only.

frozen_baselines.description: Same paid-cell budget, pooled without target-profile weighting.
Same paid-cell budget with equal repo coverage and unweighted repo summaries.
Recent tasks selected first within each repo, retained as a simple temporal comparator.
Uses deterministic blocking by repo, time bucket, source class, and task family; informative only unless promoted by a future preregistration.
Historical weighted design retained only as a diagnostic because the paid pilot threshold was not met.
